claude_proposed_widenings.name: rest_time_choice_grant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature's mechanical pattern is: Long Rest completion triggers a player choice from a closed enum (land type), which determines which prepared-spell list is granted for the next adventuring day. No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family models this. The 'activation' family assumes player-turn activation with action-economy cost and a use-count resource — none of which applies here. A new family (e.g. 'rest_grant' or 'conditional_prepared_grant') is required, capturing: trigger=long_rest, choice=one_of_N_options, effect=grant_spell_access conditioned on choice × class_level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, choose one type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. Consult the table below that corresponds to the chosen type; you have the spells listed for your Druid level and lower prepared.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access variant on ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureEffect = GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. The v4 taxonomy includes a 'grant_spell_access' atom (Section 9, Effect Atoms), but it is not surfaced in the TS type for class features. This unit needs it, as do analogous domain/oath/circle spell features across clerics, paladins, and druids. Adding grant_spell_access to ClassFeatureEffect is a prerequisite for encoding any 'bonus prepared spell list' subclass feature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you have the spells listed for your Druid level and lower prepared. [Arid L3: Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt; L5: Fireball; L7: Blight; L9: Wall of Stone … etc.]

claude_proposed_widenings.name: level_gated_list variant on grant_spell_access payload
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The granted spells are not a flat list — they unlock progressively by class level (L3 grants 3 spells, L5 adds 1 more, L7 adds 1 more, L9 adds 1 more). This is distinct from a simple 'all spells prepared at once' grant. The grant_spell_access effect needs a way to express a level-gated roster, keyed on class level thresholds.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Druid Level 3: Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt | Level 5: Fireball | Level 7: Blight | Level 9: Wall of Stone (one table of four; three other land-type tables follow the same pattern).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: branching_choice variant for rest-time player decision
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The druid chooses one of four mutually exclusive land types at long rest. The v4 taxonomy has a 'choose' procedure atom, but ClassFeatureMechanics has no mechanism to express a rest-time player choice that gates which downstream effect fires. This is structurally distinct from the existing choose_up_to target selection (which is a cast-time spell attachment choice, not a character-state-changing rest-time decision).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: choose one type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical
